\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{graphs}

\begin{document}
\tikz
  \graph[
    grow right=1.4cm,
    branch down=1cm,
    nodes={draw,circle,minimum size=6mm},
    edges={thick}
  ] {
    a -> {b,c} -> d;
  };
\end{document}
